name: Konbini Life
source:
After flunking out of University, Natsu has been working the night shift at the local MegaKonbiniMart to make ends meet.
She's got an annoying co-worker who calls her "Flunkee-chan" whose sole purpose in life is to make her miserable.
There's the creepy businessman who's only interests are of the 2D persuasion, and he can't help scaring away other customers.
The foreigner who buys snacks in bulk and is hiding a secret. And there's signs of a customer with sticky fingers.

How will Natsu's Konbini Life unfold?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=38904]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
大学挂科退学后，夏津在当地MegaKonbiniMart上夜班维持生计。

她有一个烦人的同事，整天叫她“挂科妹”，人生唯一乐趣就是让她痛苦。

还有一名古怪商人，只对二次元感兴趣，总是不经意吓跑其他客人。大量购买零食、隐藏秘密的外国人，以及一名手脚不干净的顾客留下的蛛丝马迹。

夏津的便利店生活将如何展开？
